funding.name: Maryland New Start Grant Program
funding.provider: Maryland Department of Labor, Division of Workforce Development and Adult Learning

funding.eligibility: Returning citizens transitioning back to the community from incarceration.

funding.name: Maryland Apprenticeship Incentive Program
funding.provider: Maryland Department of Labor, Office of Apprenticeship
funding.provides: Per-apprentice reimbursement that helps Maryland registered apprenticeship sponsors and employers offset the cost of recruiting and training Registered Apprentices.
funding.eligibility: Maryland Registered Apprenticeship sponsors and employers.
funding.amount: Up to $3,000 per adult Registered Apprentice, per the page.

funding.name: Become an Apprentice (Maryland)
funding.provider: Maryland Department of Labor, Office of Apprenticeship
funding.provides: Guide explaining that apprentices are paid jobs from day one and that people can search Maryland's Apprenticeship Locator by county, occupation, industry or sponsor to find a program.
funding.how_to_apply: Search the Maryland Apprenticeship Locator, then contact the program for positions and requirements.

funding.name: Maryland Career Pathways Program
funding.provider: Maryland Department of Labor, Division of Workforce Development and Adult Learning
funding.provides: State career pathways grant program; the page defines a career pathway as aligned education, training and services that prepare an individual for postsecondary education or registered apprenticeship.

funding.name: Maryland State Apprenticeship and Training Fund
funding.provider: Maryland Department of Labor, Office of Apprenticeship
funding.provides: Explains that contractors on certain public works contracts contribute to apprenticeship, through a registered program, a contribution to an organization running one, or a fund payment.
funding.eligibility: Contractors and certain subcontractors on certain public work contracts.

funding.name: Maryland Financial Aid Resources (MHEC)
funding.provides: MHEC index of state financial aid for higher education, including grants, scholarships and other awards, both need-based and merit-based.
